properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 7 at 9:00PM EDT until October 7 at 9:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Tampa Bay waters...

* Until 930 PM EDT.

* At 859 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 12 nm
northeast of Gandy Bridge to near Hillsborough Bay, moving east at
20 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels, and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots,
suddenly higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Hillsborough Bay.

properties.headline: Air Quality Alert issued October 7 at 7:17PM CDT by NWS Memphis TN
properties.description:
AQAMEG

The Shelby County Health Department has issued a Code Orange Ozone
Forecast effective for Shelby County Tennessee, Crittenden County
Arkansas, and DeSoto County Mississippi, including the city of
Memphis for Thursday. This ozone forecast is due to forecasted ozone
values that will be unhealthy for sensitive groups. These values will
exceed the Environmental Protection Agency's federal safe health
standard. The Shelby County Health Department recommends that
sensitive groups which include active children and adults, and
people with respiratory disease, such as asthma, limit prolonged
outdoor exertion.

Please continue to check the latest air quality forecasts and updates
until monitored values return to safe levels. For more information go
to www.airnow.gov.
properties.note: Non-Weather Emergency Message. Not sent to IPAWS.
